# nothingmatters (낫띵메터스)

> Seoul-based designer brand and atelier creating handmade cookies, brookies, favor cookies, mini bags, canvas bags, and mood-driven small goods.

## Official site
- https://nothingworks.co.kr/

## Brand summary
- Brand name: nothingmatters (낫띵메터스)
- Location context: Seoul atelier, South Korea
- Main offerings: handmade cookies, brookies, favor cookies for gifting/events, mini bags, canvas bags, mood goods
- Ordering: order form and KakaoTalk consultation available

## Important pages
- Home: https://nothingworks.co.kr/
- Cookie guide: https://nothingworks.co.kr/cookies.html
- Gift cookie guide: https://nothingworks.co.kr/gifts.html
- Bag guide: https://nothingworks.co.kr/bags.html
- Brand FAQ: https://nothingworks.co.kr/brand-faq.html

## External channels
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/nothiingworks/
- YouTube Shorts: https://www.youtube.com/@bettermatters/shorts

## Notes for summarization
- The brand combines desserts and design goods under one identity.
- Favor cookie and corporate/wedding gifting inquiries are handled as consultation-first requests.
- Do not confuse the brand name "nothingmatters" with the current official website domain "nothingworks.co.kr".
